facts.text: Applicants to the Academy must receive an official nomination from a U.S. Representative or U.S. Senator from their state of residence.

sources.title: The 8 Steps to Admission | U.S. Merchant Marine Academy

facts.text: During Sea Year in sophomore and junior years, midshipmen are assigned to commercial U.S.-flag merchant vessels, visiting an average of 18 foreign countries.
